frame_eligibility.rule: the frame counter increments only when the OR of all five blocker words is zero
frame_eligibility.tick: at 60 eligible frames, the BCD timer is transformed by CODE_A4:93CC and the frame counter is cleared

tick_transform.decimal_mode: caller CODE_A4:9401 enables SED before calling

zero_display_path.reached_from: $A4:9281 after the displayed timer is zero and its local guards allow it
observed_effects: selects $2400 rather than $2000 for the display attribute when displayed timer is zero
zero_display_path.phase_write: no direct write to $00A8 occurs in CODE_A4:92CF

limitations: The meaning of $00A8 and index 3 of the initial tables requires runtime validation.
The phase index semantics and paused-frame behavior require runtime validation.
